missionPremise: Same as CP1. Split 77 missing flood coverage FIPS into atoms-present vs atoms-absent without a heap COUNT(*).

querySnapshot.missingRowSql: SELECT m.county_fips, m.county_name FROM county_manifest m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM county_facet_coverage c WHERE c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = 'flood') ORDER BY m.county_fips
querySnapshot.missingCountSql: SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS missing_n FROM county_manifest m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM county_facet_coverage c WHERE c.county_fips = m.county_fips AND c.facet = 'flood')
querySnapshot.announce: not a heavy scan, 76 index probes plus two instrument-fire controls. Unique index atoms_entity_composite_unique ON public.atoms USING btree (entity_type, entity_id). Never COUNT(*) atoms. Never GROUP BY flood-hazard-fact. Never left(entity_id,5).
